mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes(user_id, title, text, audio_path, summary, category) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{text}, #{audioPath}, #{summary}, #{category})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notes WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM notes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{category} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM notes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (category IS NULL OR category = '') ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM notes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET category = #{newName} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{oldName}
UPDATE notes SET category = '' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{name}
UPDATE notes SET text = #{text} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notes SET summary = #{summary} WHERE id = #{id}
